channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Rui Hachimura | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Rui Hachimura from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: JJ Redick on Rui Hachimura
item.description:
Mike Trudell:JJ Redick on Rui Hachimura:

“I thought Rui had an outstanding season, and he was incredibly important to what we were able to do this year. He was a vital cog on both sides of the ball. The games that he missed, it was apparent to the coaching staff how valuable he was. Particularly in the last two games, I thought he played extremely well in the playoffs. I’m excited to see his growth.”

JJ Redick on Rui Hachimura, May 1, 2025. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Rui Hachimura
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Anthony Davis on his missed late free throws and Rui Hachimura’s offensive rebound to retain possession for LAL:

“My wife even called me and said, ‘Rui saved you.’ So that made me feel worse.”

Anthony Davis on Rui Hachimura, Dec 22, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Rui Hachimura
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Anthony Davis on his missed late free throws and Rui Hachimura’s offensive rebound to retain possession for LAL:

“My wife even called me and said, ‘Rui saved you.’ So that made me feelworse.”

Anthony Davis on Rui Hachimura, Dec 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on LeBron James, Rui Hachimura
item.description:
Pelinka on Hachimura:

“Watching Rui come here after the trade felt like a personal renaissance for him. He came alive as a player again. And he parlayed that this offeseason with really incredibile work. He spent most of his time training with LeBron – that was intentional.”

Rob Pelinka on LeBron James, Rui Hachimura, Sep 28, 2023. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Desmond Bane on Rui Hachimura
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Desmond Bane on Rui Hachimura:

“It’s probably the best game of his career. It’s a seven-game series. Let’s see if he can do it again Wednesday.”

Desmond Bane on Rui Hachimura, Apr 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Darvin Ham on Rui Hachimura
item.description:
Darvin Ham on Rui Hachimura:

“I’m super-duper excited. … I’ve always been impressed by him. Just a multi-faceted, strong, athletic, skilled young player. … I think he’s gonna bring a lot.”

Darvin Ham on Rui Hachimura, Jan 24, 2023. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: Wes Unseld Jr on Rui Hachimura, Corey Kispert
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Wes Unseld Jr. on Kispert saying Rui Hachimura will be back sooner than later:

“I would agree with that. He's been around more [in recent days and weeks]... physically in the facility.”

Wes Unseld Jr on Rui Hachimura, Corey Kispert, Nov 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Wes Unseld Jr on Rui Hachimura
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Wes Unseld Jr. on the continued absence of Rui Hachimura due to personal reasons:

“Right now, we're still giving him the time he needs...when he's ready, we'll put him in the mix and see what he's got.”

Wes Unseld Jr on Rui Hachimura, Oct 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Tommy Sheppard on Rui Hachimura, Deni Avdija
item.description:
Chase Hughes:GM Tommy Sheppard on roles for Rui Hachimura and Deni Avdija moving forward:

“I don't see Rui's role changing. He's started since his rookie year.”

Tommy Sheppard on Rui Hachimura, Deni Avdija, Aug 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Rui Hachimura
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Scott Brooks on Rui Hachimura's knee soreness:

“It's coming along. It's nothing to be too concerned with...who knows, he might be back tomorrow.”

Scott Brooks on Rui Hachimura, Apr 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Russell Westbrook, Rui Hachimura
item.description:
ChaseHughes: Scott Brooks on Rui Hachimura:

“I talked about it [to the team] today, and Russell [Westbrook] mentioned it today, he's the only guy on our team that can guard one through five.”

Scott Brooks on Russell Westbrook, Rui Hachimura, Jan 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant, Rui Hachimura
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Scott Brooks on Rui Hachimura playing SF and Thomas Bryant at PF next season:

“We will definitely take a look at it,depending on the makeup of the rest of our team.”

Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant, Rui Hachimura, Aug 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Rui Hachimura
item.description:
#Wizards Coach Scott Brooks on Rui Hachimura's recent 0 for 14 shooting:

“I never really look at players who struggle and think that’s always bad. Yeah, he doesn’t want to not make any shots in a game but to grow as a player, you have to grow through adversity.”

Scott Brooks on Rui Hachimura, Mar 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Rui Hachimura
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on Rui Hachimura having the top-selling NBA jersey in Japan:

“He told me also I was top 30 in coaches there, as well.”

Scott Brooks on Rui Hachimura, Feb 26, 2020. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Mark Tatum on Rui Hachimura
item.description:
“Japan is a market where we have been in for about 30 years. We’ve been in games there but one of the big difference makers has been a player like Rui Hachimura,”

Mark Tatum on Rui Hachimura, Dec 15, 2019. Source: Yahoo! Finance.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Chauncey Billups, Kawhi Leonard, Rui Hachimura
item.description:
Fred Katz:Doc Rivers on Chauncey Billups comparing Rui Hachimura to Kawhi Leonard:

“I wouldn’t want that. That’s too early. Let him be him... But everything I hear about him, forget the basketball part, is that he’s supposed to be a great kid. And that helps.”

Doc Rivers on Chauncey Billups, Kawhi Leonard, Rui Hachimura, Dec 1, 2019. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Rui Hachimura
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Wizards rookie F Rui Hachimura:

“He’s a wonderful player. He’s a class act. He’s powerful and he’s got a great work ethic. He’s just going to get better and better as he gets comfortable with the way the NBA plays and that sort of thing. He is a wonderful player.”

Gregg Popovich on Rui Hachimura, Oct 26, 2019. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.
